coverage_explanation: Tests serial state correctness with pin 4 held LOW throughout: reporting "Button not pressed" is forbidden because the button is pressed. No positive-report deadline, polling frequency, or startup deadline is imposed. The requirement supplies no timing bound, so a finite test cannot independently require eventual reporting or reliably test transitions without potentially rejecting a slower conforming implementation. Released-state behavior, transitions, and reporting liveness remain uncovered.
assumptions: The explicit circuit overrides bench defaults: pin 4 uses an external 10kΩ pull-up to 5V, and pressing the button connects it to GND.
The button is already pressed when the Arduino powers up and remains pressed throughout the test.
Serial communication uses the supplied 9600 baud setting and line_or_idle framing.
No startup deadline, polling interval, response deadline, or minimum reporting frequency is specified. The finite observation horizon is not treated as such a requirement.
